Title: Delivered pages emit relative canonical/og:url tags and sign-in/account pages are indexable
Description: Found during MVP-021 pre-work. A production-build probe with the same metadata shape as the product/category pages emitted relative canonical and og:url values and a localhost-based og:image (no metadataBase is set); sign-in and account pages carry no robots directive. No production deployment exists so nothing was exposed. Resolved by MVP-021 (PR #5, FR-017). See planning/bugs/BUG-001.md.

Title: A repeated query parameter (?q=a&q=b) makes /search and category pages return HTTP 500
Description: normalizeQuery calls .trim() on a value Next.js passes as an array for a repeated parameter, so /search and category pages throw TypeError and return 500. Found while verifying MVP-021 against real pages; the code is unchanged by MVP-021 and out of its scope (MVP-004 search behavior may not be modified). See planning/bugs/BUG-002.md. Resolved 2026-09-28 by MVP-026 (was PROP-006): the first value of a repeated parameter is used.

Title: Keyboard focus indicator is invisible on primary-coloured controls (the Search button)
Description: Focus outline is currentColor, so it is near-white on the white-text Search button over a white page: 1.06:1 measured (WCAG 2.4.7, 1.4.11). axe cannot detect it. See planning/bugs/BUG-003.md.

Title: Search input boundary and placeholder text are below contrast thresholds
Description: Input border 1.35:1 against the page (needs 3:1, WCAG 1.4.11) and placeholder 3.46:1 (needs 4.5:1, WCAG 1.4.3); the placeholder is the only visible label. See planning/bugs/BUG-004.md.

Title: Sign-in: generic error, focus dropped after submit, unstyled page and non-descriptive title
Description: Empty or invalid email yields only a generic error that does not identify the field (3.3.1, 3.3.3); focus falls to body after submit (2.4.3); page is unstyled; title is the site name (2.4.2). See planning/bugs/BUG-005.md.

Title: Account sessions: focus lost and nothing announced after revoking a session; unstyled page
Description: Revoke removes the session silently (4.1.3) and drops focus to body (2.4.3); page is unstyled with a site-name title (2.4.2). See planning/bugs/BUG-006.md.

Title: Heading levels skipped (h1 then h3) in product card lists on category and search pages
Description: ProductCard titles are h3 with no h2 between; axe heading-order (best-practice) on category and search pages at every width. See planning/bugs/BUG-007.md.

Title: The default 404 page has no main landmark and a non-descriptive title
Description: No custom not-found page exists; axe landmark-one-main and region on the framework default, title is the site name (2.4.2). See planning/bugs/BUG-008.md.

Title: The sign-in and account sessions pages are unstyled (advisory)
Description: Both pages use browser-default styling. Not a WCAG A/AA failure (accessibility rubric P4); deliberately not restyled in MVP-023. See planning/bugs/BUG-009.md. Resolved 2026-09-30 by MVP-027 slice 4: design-system defaults for unstyled elements (sign-in markup unchanged).

Title: Session revoke: keyboard focus is still lost when the revoke request fails
Description: The Revoke button is disabled while its request runs, which drops focus; MVP-023 F7 fixed the success path only. See planning/bugs/BUG-010.md.

Title: Sign-in stays in its sending state forever if the sign-in request throws
Description: handleSubmit has no try/catch around signIn(); a network failure leaves the form stuck until reload (unchanged behavior). See planning/bugs/BUG-011.md.

Title: A production build opens a new Postgres connection pool for every database query (@ppu/db does not cache its client when NODE_ENV=production)
Description: Reproduced: 40 queries leave 41 open connections in production mode and 1 in development. Caused three HTTP 500 test failures in MVP-023's first CI run (Postgres too many clients, Prisma P2037). Root-fixed by MVP-023 (commit e43e1aa): the client is now cached on globalThis in every environment, not only development/test. Confirmed by the actual merged CI run (35702619219, commit 7e10c4a): 0 TooManyConnections/P2037 occurrences in the raw log. Open question 43 is DECIDED (option A). See planning/bugs/BUG-012.md.

Title: Document title briefly disappears in Firefox after revoking a session (router.refresh())
Status: Mitigation applied (candidate a); root cause, awaiting approval
Description: Firefox only, 2 of 5 CI runs, never reproduced locally: <title> element is removed from <head> entirely during router.refresh() after a revoke; Next's own route announcer read document.title as empty at that moment (direct evidence), corroborated by the failure-time HTML snapshot showing no <title> element. Classified product-defect by the pre-registered criterion. See planning/bugs/BUG-013.md.

Title: Firefox @320px: sign-in submit produces no network request and no client validation (intermittent, unexplained)
Status: Open - monitoring, permanently instrumented, three occurrences across sixteen CI runs, not blocking
Description: Retitled after a second occurrence (run 7): same control, same engine, same width, no handler effect. A third occurrence (run 15) recurred on a fully self-check-verified instrument; evidence is STILL UNREADABLE (neither TEST DEFECT nor PRODUCT DEFECT under any criterion applied so far). Same cause is suspected, not proven. Extended failure-evidence instrumentation (hit test, hydration marker, click/submit event trace, observer liveness, navigation events, native-submit detection) now captures this on any recurrence. Does not block MVP-023; MVP-023 merged with this record open. See planning/bugs/BUG-014.md.

Title: catalog-repository.integration.test.ts's listSitemapEntries test can see a PUBLISHED product created by a concurrently-running package's own integration suite
Description: Found while verifying CI on PR #12 (accessibility suite sharding, unrelated). @ppu/adapter-catalog and @ppu/adapter-entitlements' integration suites can run concurrently against the same shared CI Postgres container with no cross-package isolation; entitlements' entitlement-repo-product fixture landed inside catalog's two-call sitemap-order assertion, failing it once. Confirmed flaky, not deterministic, by re-running the identical commit's job (passed clean). A second, structurally identical race in the same file (category-eligibility check) was found during this fix's pre-work. Resolved 2026-09-24 by schema-per-package test isolation (both races reproduced deterministically before, confirmed absent after). See planning/bugs/BUG-015.md.

Title: Accessibility-suite fixture cleanup can fail: EmailSend rows block deleting the fixture user
Description: EmailSend.userId is a Restrict FK and fixture cleanup never deleted EmailSend rows; WebKit delivers requests the harness held open (interceptAndHold) when the page closes, so the real deletion-request POST ran during teardown, after cleanup, and the user delete failed (CI run 36664530308; reproduced locally). Held requests are now aborted after every test, and cleanup also deletes EmailSend rows. See planning/bugs/BUG-016.md.

Title: The design-token guard test fails on a Windows CRLF checkout
Description: lib/design-tokens.test.ts looked for LF-only block ends; on a core.autocrlf checkout it scanned past the block. It now normalises line endings. See planning/bugs/BUG-017.md.

Title: Next.js 16.3.5 is affected by a critical RCE advisory in next/og ImageResponse (GHSA-vcvr-r3jv-pc5j)
Description: Advisory published 2026-09-30 for next >=16.2.0 <16.3.6; the web app was on 16.3.5 and renders share images with next/og. CI's dependency audit failed on PR #45. Our share image passes no explicit SVG and its text comes only from published rows, so it's very likely not exploitable, but it was upgraded regardless. next and @next/eslint-plugin-next were raised to ^16.3.7 (not 16.3.8, which would have needed minimum-release-age exceptions). No production deployment exists, so nothing was exposed. See planning/bugs/BUG-018.md.

Title: Without an email provider, production wrote sign-in links (working credentials) and addresses to the logs
Description: ConsoleEmailAdapter was the production fallback when RESEND_API_KEY was unset, logging recipients and full sign-in links. Production now fails closed (UnconfiguredEmailAdapter, logs nothing); the console transport runs only outside production or when a harness sets EMAIL_TRANSPORT=log. No deployment existed, so nothing was exposed. See planning/bugs/BUG-019.md.

Title: Any signed-in user could request file upload URLs, though only the admin publishes
Description: POST /api/files/uploads and /complete checked only for a session. Both now require ADMIN (role re-queried from the database) and return the admin routes' identical 404 otherwise. Storage is not configured for launch, so nothing was exposed. See planning/bugs/BUG-020.md.

Title: Netlify builds fail: netlify.toml publish path was relative to the package directory, not the base directory
Description: apps/web/netlify.toml had publish = \.next\"; Netlify resolves netlify.toml paths from the base directory (repo root)
column9: so @netlify/plugin-nextjs looked for /opt/build/repo/.next and every git build failed after a successful compile. Now publish = \"apps/web/.next\". The previous deploy stayed live. See planning/bugs/BUG-021.md."

Title: Saving an article in the admin editor cleared its technology section
Description: ArticleForm showed the technology picker but never sent its value, so every create or save stored technology = null and the article left its hub. Fixed in MVP-033 slice B: the form sends technology and topic. See planning/bugs/BUG-022.md.

Title: No clickjacking protection or referrer policy, and the deployment guide pointed admins at a missing /admin page
Description: The configuration review found no CSP frame-ancestors, X-Frame-Options, Referrer-Policy or Permissions-Policy on the live site, and docs/15-deployment.md sent admins to /admin, which 404d. Fixed in MVP-034: security headers on every page, and an /admin home page.

Title: The admin product editor overflowed a 320px screen when a file scan id was wide
Description: A random 25-character file scan id in the releases list sometimes made /admin/products/[id]/edit 325px wide at 320px (intermittent gate failure, Firefox). Fixed in the MVP-036 PR: the id may now break anywhere. Full record: planning/bugs/BUG-024.md

Title: sharp 0.35.4 is affected by a high-severity librsvg advisory (GHSA-wq5f-xc86-pv6w)
Description: Advisory published 2026-10-06; CI dependency audit failed on every branch. Lockfile updated to sharp 0.35.5 (next allows ^0.35.4). App does not use next/image or sharp directly, so exposure very likely none. Full record: planning/bugs/BUG-025.md

Title: Guide pages: Copy link slid under the sticky contents list, and the side column could hide its cards
Description: Reported by the product owner with screenshots. The whole left column (contents list and Copy link) is now sticky together and scrolls on its own; the side column scrolls when taller than the window, and long words wrap. Full record: planning/bugs/BUG-026.md

Title: A traffic burst filled the database pooler's 200 client connections and the live site returned 500
Description: About 07:20-07:31 UTC: Supavisor EMAXCONN (limit 200); 275 connections opened in 5 minutes. Each Netlify function instance kept a default pg pool of up to 10. Pool now max 3, idle 5 s. Full record: planning/bugs/BUG-027.md

Title: After a vote, focus sometimes did not move to the thanks (Firefox, WebKit); develop accessibility gate failed
Description: GuideFeedback moved focus with requestAnimationFrame, which could run before React rendered the (empty, hidden) thanks. Focus now moves in an effect after render; the learn-voted gate state waits for the thanks to have focus. Full record: planning/bugs/BUG-028.md

Title: Guide pages: the On this page bar did not follow the section being read
Description: Reported by the product owner with a screenshot. TocSpy now marks the section being read (aria-current=location) and ArticleToc styles it. Full record: planning/bugs/BUG-029.md

Title: Admin deletion requests could fail with a server error while a request was being deleted
Description: Found by the gate on PR #112 (500 in Firefox). The listing's two reads aren't one snapshot; a request deleted between them came back with no events. It's now skipped, and the gate's fixtures change deletion requests atomically. Full record: planning/bugs/BUG-030.md

Title: The keyboard check could start before an error moved focus; develop's gate failed on password-reset-weak
Description: Found by the gate on develop after #120. The reset form moves focus to the field after the error paints; the gate state waited only for the text, so the keyboard walk could start first and miss the header (the BUG-028 race). Six error states now wait for focus to land. Full record: planning/bugs/BUG-031.md

Title: The header broke onto two rows at desktop widths when signed in as an admin
Description: Reported by the product owner with a screenshot. Admin, the Account label, the Updates badge and Components no longer fitted the 1,217-pixel bar. Admin moved into the account area, the avatar alone is the Account button, the wordmark is screen-reader-only from 1024 to 1279 pixels, and spacing is tighter. Full record: planning/bugs/BUG-032.md

Title: On phones, component previews wider than the screen were cut off on the right
Description: Found while checking the People picker at 375 px. The preview screen centred components in a grid whose column grew to fit them, so max-w-full did nothing and overflow-hidden cut off the Text field (340 px in 285 px). The column is now minmax(0, 1fr); all nine previews fit at 320 and 375 px. Full record: planning/bugs/BUG-033.md

Title: At 320px, the welcome page heading and the profile display name could widen the page in Firefox
Description: Found by the gate on #125, #126 and #127 after #124 merged (339 to 345 px in a 320 px viewport, only sometimes). The bare h1 was 44 px, too big for the word LowCodeStacks on a phone; the profile name could not wrap inside a word. The bare h1 is 36 px on phones and wraps long words; the name wraps anywhere. Full record: planning/bugs/BUG-034.md

Title: WebKit's keyboard check sometimes found no keyboard stops on a 404 page
Description: Three gate runs after #124 (admin-updates-denied, admin-products-denied, admin-components-denied); 0 of 24 locally. The 404 states started the walk before the page hydrated; a re-render can drop focus to the body, which ends the walk. All 21 404 states now wait for the hydrated Page not found heading. Full record: planning/bugs/BUG-035.md

Title: After sending a note in Did this fix it?, the box stayed open with the note in it
Description: Reported by the product owner with a screenshot. On sending, the form only removed its Send button and disabled the text box, so the box and the note stayed on screen and focus was left on a removed button. The form now closes, the thanks takes its place and focus moves to it. Full record: planning/bugs/BUG-036.md

Title: On this page marked the section before the one being read
Description: Reported by the product owner. The panel sticks, but its highlight counted a heading as being read only within 140 px of the top, under the 100 px sticky header, so on every one of 64 live pages it marked the previous section and never the first. The reading line is now a third of the way down (at least 160 px); checked on 60 guides in Chromium and Firefox. Full record: planning/bugs/BUG-037.md

Title: The component library and site switch tables were created without row-level security
Description: Found by the agent while adding MVP-050's tables. library_components, component_events, site_switches and site_switch_events had no RLS, unlike every other table (docs/final-decisions.md, RLS implementation note); with the Supabase anon key, which the site never publishes, PostgREST could read or change them. A migration turns RLS on for the four, and a new test fails CI for any table created without it. Full record: planning/bugs/BUG-038.md
